import { useEffect, useState } from "react";
import { Link } from "react-router-dom";
import { axiosClient } from "@/api/axiosClient";
import { formatDateFr } from "@/lib/dates";

interface ContratListItem {
  id: number;
  codeContratCb: string;
  typeContrat: string;
  phaseDemande: string;
  dateDemande: string;
  client: { prenom: string; nom: string; codeClientCb: string };
}

export function HistoriqueRapportsPage() {
  const [contrats, setContrats] = useState<ContratListItem[]>([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);

  useEffect(() => {
    axiosClient.get<ContratListItem[]>("/contrats").then((res) => setContrats(res.data)).finally(() => setLoading(false));
  }, []);

  if (loading) return <div className="mx-auto max-w-5xl p-6 text-slate-500">Chargement...</div>;

  return (
    <div className="mx-auto max-w-5xl space-y-4 p-6">
      <h2 className="text-2xl font-semibold text-slate-900">Historique des rapports</h2>
      <div className="overflow-hidden rounded-lg border bg-white">
        <table className="w-full text-base">
          <thead className="bg-slate-50 text-left text-sm text-slate-600">
            <tr>
              <th className="p-3">Client</th><th>Code Client CB</th><th>Contrat</th><th>Date demande</th><th>Phase</th><th>Rapport</th>
            </tr>
          </thead>
          <tbody>
            {contrats.map((c) => (
              <tr key={c.id} className="border-t hover:bg-slate-50">
                <td className="p-3">
                  <Link to={`/demande/rapport/${c.id}`} className="font-medium text-slate-800 hover:underline">
                    {[c.client.prenom, c.client.nom].filter(Boolean).join(" ")}
                  </Link>
                </td>
                <td>{c.client.codeClientCb}</td>
                <td>{c.codeContratCb}</td>
                <td>{formatDateFr(c.dateDemande)}</td>
                <td>{c.phaseDemande}</td>
                <td className="p-3">
                  <Link to={`/demande/rapport/${c.id}`} className="font-medium text-primary underline underline-offset-2">
                    Ouvrir le rapport
                  </Link>
                </td>
              </tr>
            ))}
            {contrats.length === 0 && (
              <tr><td colSpan={6} className="p-6 text-center text-slate-500">Aucun contrat disponible.</td></tr>
            )}
          </tbody>
        </table>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

File: bic-frontend/src/pages/LoginPage.tsx

import { useRef, useState, type FormEvent, type KeyboardEvent } from "react";
import { useNavigate } from "react-router-dom";
import { Eye, EyeOff } from "lucide-react";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { Input } from "@/components/ui/input";
import { Label } from "@/components/ui/label";
import { Card, CardContent, CardHeader, CardTitle } from "@/components/ui/card";
import { useAuth } from "@/context/AuthContext";

export function LoginPage() {
  const { login } = useAuth();
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const [nomUtilisateur, setNomUtilisateur] = useState("");
  const [motDePasse, setMotDePasse] = useState("");
  const [afficherMotDePasse, setAfficherMotDePasse] = useState(false);
  const [erreur, setErreur] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [submitting, setSubmitting] = useState(false);
  const motDePasseRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);

  async function onSubmit(e: FormEvent) {
    e.preventDefault();
    setErreur(null);
    setSubmitting(true);
    try {
      await login(nomUtilisateur, motDePasse);
      navigate("/");
    } catch {
      setErreur("Identifiants invalides.");
    } finally {
      setSubmitting(false);
    }
  }

  function onIdentifiantKeyDown(e: KeyboardEvent<HTMLInputElement>) {
    if (e.key === "Enter") { e.preventDefault(); motDePasseRef.current?.focus(); }
  }

  return (
    <div className="flex min-h-screen items-center justify-center bg-slate-50">
      <Card className="w-full max-w-sm">
        <CardHeader><CardTitle>BIC — CECAM</CardTitle><p className="text-sm text-slate-500">Connexion</p></CardHeader>
        <CardContent>
          <form onSubmit={onSubmit} className="space-y-4">
            <div className="space-y-1.5">
              <Label>Nom d'utilisateur</Label>
              <Input value={nomUtilisateur} onChange={(e) => setNomUtilisateur(e.target.value)} onKeyDown={onIdentifiantKeyDown} autoFocus />
            </div>
            <div className="space-y-1.5">
              <Label>Mot de passe</Label>
              <div className="relative">
                <Input ref={motDePasseRef} type={afficherMotDePasse ? "text" : "password"} value={motDePasse}
                  onChange={(e) => setMotDePasse(e.target.value)} className="pr-9" />
                <button type="button" onClick={() => setAfficherMotDePasse((v) => !v)}
                  className="absolute right-2 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-600" tabIndex={-1}
                  aria-label={afficherMotDePasse ? "Masquer le mot de passe" : "Afficher le mot de passe"}>
                  {afficherMotDePasse ? <EyeOff className="size-4" /> : <Eye className="size-4" />}
                </button>
              </div>
            </div>
            {erreur && <p className="text-sm text-red-500">{erreur}</p>}
            <Button type="submit" className="w-full" disabled={submitting}>{submitting ? "Connexion..." : "Se connecter"}</Button>
          </form>
        </CardContent>
      </Card>
    </div>
  );
}

package mg.cecam.bic.client;

import com.fasterxml.jackson.annotation.JsonIgnore;
import jakarta.persistence.*;
import jakarta.validation.constraints.NotBlank;
import lombok.*;

@Entity
@Table(name = "identifiant", uniqueConstraints = @UniqueConstraint(name = "uq_identifiant_type_numero", columnNames = {"type_identifiant", "numero"}))
@Getter @Setter @NoArgsConstructor @AllArgsConstructor @Builder
public class Identifiant {

    @Id
    @GeneratedValue(strategy = GenerationType.IDENTITY)
    private Long id;

    @ManyToOne(fetch = FetchType.LAZY)
    @JoinColumn(name = "client_id", nullable = false)
    @JsonIgnore
    private Client client;

    @NotBlank
    @Column(name = "type_identifiant", nullable = false)
    private String typeIdentifiant;

    @NotBlank
    @Column(nullable = false)
    private String numero;
}

package mg.cecam.bic.config;

import lombok.RequiredArgsConstructor;
import mg.cecam.bic.auth.JwtAuthenticationFilter;
import org.springframework.boot.web.servlet.FilterRegistrationBean;
import org.springframework.context.annotation.Bean;
import org.springframework.context.annotation.Configuration;
import org.springframework.beans.factory.annotation.Value;
import org.springframework.core.Ordered;
import org.springframework.security.config.annotation.method.configuration.EnableMethodSecurity;
import org.springframework.security.config.annotation.web.builders.HttpSecurity;
import org.springframework.security.config.annotation.web.configuration.EnableWebSecurity;
import org.springframework.security.config.http.SessionCreationPolicy;
import org.springframework.security.crypto.bcrypt.BCryptPasswordEncoder;
import org.springframework.security.crypto.password.PasswordEncoder;
import org.springframework.security.web.SecurityFilterChain;
import org.springframework.security.web.authentication.UsernamePasswordAuthenticationFilter;
import org.springframework.web.cors.CorsConfiguration;
import org.springframework.web.cors.CorsConfigurationSource;
import org.springframework.web.cors.UrlBasedCorsConfigurationSource;
import org.springframework.web.filter.CorsFilter;

import java.util.List;
import java.util.Arrays;

@Configuration
@EnableWebSecurity
@EnableMethodSecurity
@RequiredArgsConstructor
public class SecurityConfig {

    private final JwtAuthenticationFilter jwtAuthenticationFilter;

    @Bean
    public PasswordEncoder passwordEncoder() {
        return new BCryptPasswordEncoder();
    }

    @Bean
    public SecurityFilterChain filterChain(HttpSecurity http) throws Exception {
        http
                .csrf(csrf -> csrf.disable())
                .sessionManagement(sm -> sm.sessionCreationPolicy(SessionCreationPolicy.STATELESS))
                .authorizeHttpRequests(auth -> auth
                        .requestMatchers("/api/auth/**").permitAll()
                        .anyRequest().authenticated()
                )
                .addFilterBefore(jwtAuthenticationFilter, UsernamePasswordAuthenticationFilter.class);
        return http.build();
    }

    @Bean
    public CorsConfigurationSource corsConfigurationSource(
            @Value("${app.cors.allowed-origins:http://localhost:5173,http://localhost:5174,http://127.0.0.1:5173}") String allowedOrigins) {
    CorsConfiguration config = new CorsConfiguration();
    List<String> origins = Arrays.stream(allowedOrigins.split(","))
            .map(String::trim).filter(origin -> !origin.isEmpty()).toList();
    config.setAllowedOrigins(origins);
    config.setAllowedMethods(List.of("GET", "POST", "PUT", "PATCH", "DELETE", "OPTIONS"));
    config.setAllowedHeaders(List.of("*"));
    UrlBasedCorsConfigurationSource source = new UrlBasedCorsConfigurationSource();
    source.registerCorsConfiguration("/**", config);
    return source;
}

    @Bean
    public FilterRegistrationBean<CorsFilter> corsFilterRegistration(
            CorsConfigurationSource corsConfigurationSource) {
        FilterRegistrationBean<CorsFilter> registration =
                new FilterRegistrationBean<>(new CorsFilter(corsConfigurationSource));
        registration.setOrder(Ordered.HIGHEST_PRECEDENCE);
        registration.setName("corsFilter");
        return registration;
    }
}

File: bic-backend/src/main/java/mg/cecam/bic/contrat/Echeance.java
================
package mg.cecam.bic.contrat;

import jakarta.persistence.*;
import lombok.*;
import mg.cecam.bic.common.enums.StatutEcheance;

import java.math.BigDecimal;
import java.time.LocalDate;
import java.time.temporal.ChronoUnit;

@Entity
@Table(name = "echeance")
@Getter @Setter @NoArgsConstructor @AllArgsConstructor @Builder
public class Echeance {

    public static final int SEUIL_IMPAYE_JOURS = 30;

    @Id
    @GeneratedValue(strategy = GenerationType.IDENTITY)
    private Long id;

    @ManyToOne(fetch = FetchType.LAZY)
    @JoinColumn(name = "contrat_id", nullable = false)
    private Contrat contrat;

    @Column(name = "numero_echeance", nullable = false)
    private Integer numeroEcheance;

    @Column(name = "date_echeance", nullable = false)
    private LocalDate dateEcheance;

    @Column(name = "montant_du", nullable = false)
    private BigDecimal montantDu;

    @Column(name = "montant_paye")
    private BigDecimal montantPaye;

    @Column(name = "date_paiement")
    private LocalDate datePaiement;

    @Enumerated(EnumType.STRING)
    @Column(nullable = false, length = 20)
    private StatutEcheance statut;

    @Transient
    public boolean estPayee() {
        return montantPaye != null && montantDu != null && montantPaye.compareTo(montantDu) >= 0;
    }

    @Transient
    public int joursDeRetard(LocalDate reference) {
        LocalDate fin = estPayee()
                ? (datePaiement != null ? datePaiement : dateEcheance)
                : reference;
        if (!fin.isAfter(dateEcheance)) return 0;
        return (int) ChronoUnit.DAYS.between(dateEcheance, fin);
    }

    @Transient
    public StatutEcheance statutEffectif(LocalDate reference) {
        if (estPayee()) {
            return joursDeRetard(reference) > 0 ? StatutEcheance.EN_RETARD : StatutEcheance.PAYE_A_TEMPS;
        }
        if (dateEcheance.isAfter(reference)) return StatutEcheance.A_VENIR;
        return joursDeRetard(reference) > SEUIL_IMPAYE_JOURS ? StatutEcheance.IMPAYE : StatutEcheance.EN_RETARD;
    }

    @Transient
    public boolean estEnSouffrance(LocalDate reference) {
        return !estPayee() && !dateEcheance.isAfter(reference);
    }
}

package mg.cecam.bic.score;

public record ScoreResult(
        boolean calculable,
        Integer valeur,
        String intervalle,
        String categorieRisque,
        String couleur,
        String message
) {
    public static ScoreResult calcule(int valeur, String intervalle, String categorieRisque,
                                      String couleur, String message) {
        return new ScoreResult(true, valeur, intervalle, categorieRisque, couleur, message);
    }

    public static ScoreResult nonCalculable(String message) {
        return new ScoreResult(false, null, null, null, null, message);
    }
}

import { axiosClient } from "./axiosClient";
import type { ClientRequest, ClientResponse } from "@/types/client";

export interface ClientEnregistrementResponse {
  client: ClientResponse;
  clientTrouve: boolean;
}

export const clientApi = {
  creer: async (payload: ClientRequest): Promise<ClientEnregistrementResponse> => {
    const { data } = await axiosClient.post<ClientEnregistrementResponse>("/clients", payload);
    return data;
  },

  mettreAJour: async (id: number, payload: ClientRequest) => {
  const { data } = await axiosClient.put<ClientResponse>(`/clients/${id}`, payload);
  return data;
},
ajouterAdresse: async (id: number, payload: import("@/types/client").AdresseRequest) => {
  const { data } = await axiosClient.post(`/clients/${id}/adresses`, payload);
  return data;
},

  rechercherParCin: async (numero: string): Promise<ClientResponse | null> => {
    try {
      const { data } = await axiosClient.get<ClientResponse>("/clients/recherche", { params: { typeIdentifiant: "CIN", numero } });
      return data;
    } catch {
      return null;
    }
  },
  rechercherParCodeClientCb: async (codeClientCb: string): Promise<ClientResponse | null> => {
    try {
      const { data } = await axiosClient.get<ClientResponse>("/clients/recherche", { params: { codeClientCb } });
      return data;
    } catch {
      return null;
    }
  },

  rechercherParCodeClientEtablissement: async (codeClientEtablissement: string): Promise<ClientResponse | null> => {
    try {
      const { data } = await axiosClient.get<ClientResponse>("/clients/recherche", { params: { codeClientEtablissement } });
      return data;
    } catch {
      return null;
    }
  },

};

import { useState } from "react";
import { Link, useNavigate } from "react-router-dom";
import { cn } from "@/lib/utils";
import { useAuth } from "@/context/AuthContext";

export function TopBar() {
  const [type, setType] = useState<"individuel" | "entreprise">("individuel");
  const { nomUtilisateur, role, logout } = useAuth();
  const navigate = useNavigate();

  return (
    <header className="border-b border-border bg-card">
      <div className="mx-auto flex h-16 max-w-7xl items-center gap-6 px-6">
        <Link to="/" className="font-heading text-base font-semibold text-primary">
          BIC <span className="font-normal text-muted-foreground">CECAM</span>
        </Link>

        <nav className="flex items-center gap-1" aria-label="Type de dossier">
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => setType("individuel")}
            aria-pressed={type === "individuel"}
            className={cn(
              "rounded-md px-3 py-2 text-base transition-colors",
              type === "individuel"
                ? "bg-secondary font-medium text-secondary-foreground"
                : "text-muted-foreground hover:text-foreground",
            )}
          >
            Individuel
          </button>
          <button
            type="button"
            disabled
            title="Le module entreprise n'est pas encore ouvert"
            className="cursor-not-allowed rounded-md px-3 py-2 text-base text-muted-foreground/50"
          >
            Entreprise
          </button>
        </nav>

        <div className="ml-auto flex items-center gap-4">
          <div className="hidden text-right leading-tight sm:block">
            <div className="text-base text-foreground">{nomUtilisateur}</div>
            <div className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">
              {role === "ADMIN" ? "Administrateur" : "Agent de crédit"}
            </div>
          </div>
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => { logout(); navigate("/login"); }}
            className="text-base text-muted-foreground underline-offset-4 hover:text-foreground hover:underline"
          >
            Déconnexion
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>
    </header>
  );
}

File: bic-frontend/src/pages/MiseAJourDemandePage.tsx

import { useEffect, useState } from "react";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { Input } from "@/components/ui/input";
import { Label } from "@/components/ui/label";
import { Select, SelectContent, SelectItem, SelectTrigger, SelectValue } from "@/components/ui/select";
import { Card, CardContent, CardHeader, CardTitle } from "@/components/ui/card";
import { MontantInput } from "@/components/ui/montant-input";
import { contratApi } from "@/api/contratApi";
import { modificationContratApi } from "@/api/modificationContratApi";
import type { ContratResponse, MotifCloture, PhaseDemande } from "@/types/contrat";
import type { ModificationContratRequest, ModificationContratResponse } from "@/types/modificationContrat";
import { useToast } from "@/hooks/use-toast";

const PHASES: { value: PhaseDemande; label: string }[] = [
  { value: "DEMANDE_EN_COURS", label: "Demande en cours" },
  { value: "ACTIF", label: "Actif" },
  { value: "REFUSE", label: "Refusé" },
  { value: "FERME", label: "Fermé" },
  { value: "ABANDONNE", label: "Abandonné / Annulé" },
];
const DEVISES = ["Ariary malgache", "Euro", "Dollar américain"];
const PHASE_LABELS = Object.fromEntries(PHASES.map(({ value, label }) => [value, label])) as Record<PhaseDemande, string>;

export function MiseAJourDemandePage() {
  const { toast } = useToast();
  const [codeRecherche, setCodeRecherche] = useState("");
  const [contrat, setContrat] = useState<ContratResponse | null>(null);
  const [phase, setPhase] = useState<PhaseDemande | "">("");
  const [motif, setMotif] = useState<MotifCloture | "">("");
  const [codeContratEtablissement, setCodeContratEtablissement] = useState("");
  const [codeDemandeEtablissement, setCodeDemandeEtablissement] = useState("");
  const [montant, setMontant] = useState("");
  const [devise, setDevise] = useState("Ariary malgache");
  const [justification, setJustification] = useState("");
  const [chargement, setChargement] = useState(false);
  const [envoi, setEnvoi] = useState(false);
  const [mesDemandes, setMesDemandes] = useState<ModificationContratResponse[]>([]);

  async function chargerMesDemandes() {
    try { setMesDemandes(await modificationContratApi.listerMesDemandes()); } catch { /* La saisie reste disponible si l'historique ne charge pas. */ }
  }

  useEffect(() => { void chargerMesDemandes(); }, []);

  async function rechercher() {
    setChargement(true); setContrat(null);
    try {
      const trouve = await contratApi.rechercherParIdentifiant(codeRecherche.trim());
      if (!trouve) { toast({ title: "Demande introuvable — saisissez le code Contrat CECAM ou le code Contrat CB.", variant: "destructive" }); return; }
      setContrat(trouve);
      setPhase(trouve.phaseDemande as PhaseDemande);
      setCodeContratEtablissement(trouve.codeContratEtablissement ?? "");
      setCodeDemandeEtablissement(trouve.codeDemandeEtablissement ?? "");
      setMontant(trouve.montantEcheanceMensuelle == null ? "" : String(trouve.montantEcheanceMensuelle));
      setDevise(trouve.devise || "Ariary malgache");
      setMotif(trouve.motifCloture ?? ""); setJustification("");
    } finally { setChargement(false); }
  }

  async function soumettre() {
    if (!contrat || !phase) return;
    if (!justification.trim()) {
      toast({ title: "Justification obligatoire — expliquez la raison de la mise à jour.", variant: "destructive" });
      return;
    }
    if ((phase === "ABANDONNE" || phase === "FERME") && !motif) {
      toast({ title: "Motif obligatoire — sélectionnez le motif de clôture ou d'annulation.", variant: "destructive" });
      return;
    }
    const montantNormalise = montant.trim().replace(/[\s\u00a0]/g, "").replace(",", ".");
    const montantNumerique = montantNormalise ? Number(montantNormalise) : null;
    if (montantNumerique !== null && (!Number.isFinite(montantNumerique) || montantNumerique < 0)) {
      toast({ title: "Montant invalide", variant: "destructive" }); return;
    }

    const payload: ModificationContratRequest = {
      phaseDemande: phase,
      motifCloture: motif || null,
      codeContratEtablissement: codeContratEtablissement.trim() || null,
      codeDemandeEtablissement: codeDemandeEtablissement.trim() || null,
      montantEcheanceMensuelle: montantNumerique,
      devise,
      justification: justification.trim(),
    };
    setEnvoi(true);
    try {
      await modificationContratApi.soumettre(contrat.id, payload);
      toast({ title: "Demande envoyée à l’administrateur — changements appliqués après validation." });
      setJustification("");
      await chargerMesDemandes();
    } catch (error) {
      const status = (error as { response?: { status?: number } }).response?.status;
      toast({ title: status === 409 ? "Une demande est déjà en attente pour ce contrat." : "Envoi impossible", variant: "destructive" });
    } finally { setEnvoi(false); }
  }

  return (
    <div className="mx-auto max-w-5xl space-y-6 p-6">
      <Card>
        <CardHeader><CardTitle>Mise à jour demande — Saisie</CardTitle></CardHeader>
        <CardContent className="flex flex-col items-stretch gap-3 sm:flex-row sm:items-end">
          <div className="flex-1 space-y-1.5"><Label htmlFor="identifiant-contrat">Code Contrat CECAM ou Code Contrat CB</Label>
            <Input id="identifiant-contrat" value={codeRecherche} onChange={(e) => setCodeRecherche(e.target.value)} onKeyDown={(e) => { if (e.key === "Enter") { e.preventDefault(); void rechercher(); } }} />
          </div>
          <Button onClick={() => void rechercher()} disabled={!codeRecherche.trim() || chargement}>{chargement ? "Recherche…" : "Rechercher"}</Button>
        </CardContent>
      </Card>

      {contrat && <>
      <Card>
          <CardHeader><CardTitle>Codes relatifs à la demande</CardTitle><p className="text-base text-slate-600">Client : {[contrat.client?.prenom, contrat.client?.nom].filter(Boolean).join(" ")} · Contrat CB : {contrat.codeContratCb}</p></CardHeader>
          <CardContent className="space-y-4">
            <div className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-4 md:grid-cols-2">
              <div className="space-y-1.5"><Label htmlFor="code-contrat">Code Contrat CECAM</Label><Input id="code-contrat" value={codeContratEtablissement} onChange={(e) => setCodeContratEtablissement(e.target.value)} /></div>
              <div className="space-y-1.5"><Label htmlFor="code-demande">Code Demande CECAM</Label><Input id="code-demande" value={codeDemandeEtablissement} onChange={(e) => setCodeDemandeEtablissement(e.target.value)} /></div>
            </div>
          </CardContent>
        </Card>

        <Card>
          <CardHeader><CardTitle>Modification soumise à validation</CardTitle><p className="text-base text-slate-600">Aucun changement ne sera appliqué avant l’approbation de l’administrateur.</p></CardHeader>
          <CardContent className="space-y-5">
            <div className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-4 md:grid-cols-2">
              <div className="space-y-1.5"><Label htmlFor="phase">Phase de la demande</Label>
                <Select value={phase} onValueChange={(v) => { if (v) setPhase(v as PhaseDemande); }}>
                  <SelectTrigger id="phase"><SelectValue placeholder="Sélectionner" /></SelectTrigger>
                  <SelectContent>{PHASES.map((p) => <SelectItem key={p.value} value={p.value}>{p.label}</SelectItem>)}</SelectContent>
                </Select>
              </div>
              {(phase === "ABANDONNE" || phase === "FERME") && <div className="space-y-1.5"><Label htmlFor="motif">Motif de clôture / annulation</Label>
                <Select value={motif} onValueChange={(v) => { if (v) setMotif(v as MotifCloture); }}>
                  <SelectTrigger id="motif"><SelectValue placeholder="Sélectionner" /></SelectTrigger>
                  <SelectContent>
                    <SelectItem value="FIN_A_TERME">Fin à terme</SelectItem>
                    <SelectItem value="FIN_ANTICIPEE">Fin anticipée / annulation</SelectItem>
                  </SelectContent>
                </Select>
              </div>}
            </div>
            <div className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-4 border-t pt-4 md:grid-cols-2">
              <div className="space-y-1.5"><Label htmlFor="montant-echeance">Montant échéance mensuelle</Label><MontantInput id="montant-echeance" value={montant} onValueChange={setMontant} /></div>
              <div className="space-y-1.5"><Label>Devise</Label>
                <Select value={devise} onValueChange={(v) => { if (v) setDevise(v); }}>
                  <SelectTrigger><SelectValue /></SelectTrigger><SelectContent>{DEVISES.map((d) => <SelectItem key={d} value={d}>{d}</SelectItem>)}</SelectContent>
                </Select>
              </div>
            </div>
            <div className="space-y-1.5"><Label htmlFor="justification">Justification de la mise à jour <span className="text-red-600">*</span></Label>
              <textarea id="justification" value={justification} onChange={(e) => setJustification(e.target.value)} rows={3} maxLength={500} className="w-full rounded-lg border border-input bg-background px-3 py-2 text-base outline-none focus-visible:ring-3 focus-visible:ring-ring/50" />
            </div>
            <Button onClick={() => void soumettre()} disabled={envoi}>{envoi ? "Envoi…" : "Envoyer la demande à l’administrateur"}</Button>
          </CardContent>
        </Card>
      </>}

      <Card>
        <CardHeader><CardTitle>Mes demandes de modification</CardTitle></CardHeader>
        <CardContent>
          {mesDemandes.length === 0 ? <p className="text-base text-muted-foreground">Aucune demande envoyée.</p> :
            <ul className="divide-y">{mesDemandes.map((d) => <li key={d.id} className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-2 py-3 text-base">
              <span>{d.clientNomComplet} · {d.codeContratCb} · {PHASE_LABELS[d.phaseDemande]}</span>
              <span className={d.statut === "EN_ATTENTE" ? "font-semibold text-amber-700" : d.statut === "APPROUVEE" ? "font-semibold text-green-700" : "font-semibold text-red-700"}>
                {d.statut === "EN_ATTENTE" ? "En attente" : d.statut === "APPROUVEE" ? "Approuvée" : "Refusée"}
              </span>
              {d.statut === "REFUSEE" && d.commentaireAdmin && <p className="w-full text-sm text-slate-600">Motif du refus : {d.commentaireAdmin}</p>}
            </li>)}</ul>}
        </CardContent>
      </Card>
    </div>
  );
}

import { useState } from "react";
import { Link } from "react-router-dom";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { Input } from "@/components/ui/input";
import { Label } from "@/components/ui/label";
import { Card, CardContent, CardHeader, CardTitle } from "@/components/ui/card";
import { clientApi } from "@/api/clientApi";
import { contratApi } from "@/api/contratApi";
import type { ClientResponse } from "@/types/client";
import type { ContratResponse } from "@/types/contrat";

export function RechercheIndividuPage() {
  const [codeCb, setCodeCb] = useState("");
  const [codeEtablissement, setCodeEtablissement] = useState("");
  const [numero, setNumero] = useState("");
  const [client, setClient] = useState<ClientResponse | null>(null);
  const [contrats, setContrats] = useState<ContratResponse[]>([]);
  const [recherche, setRecherche] = useState(false);
  const [introuvable, setIntrouvable] = useState(false);

  async function rechercher() {
    setRecherche(true); setIntrouvable(false); setClient(null); setContrats([]);
    try {
      const found = codeCb.trim()
        ? await clientApi.rechercherParCodeClientCb(codeCb.trim())
        : codeEtablissement.trim()
          ? await clientApi.rechercherParCodeClientEtablissement(codeEtablissement.trim())
          : numero.trim() ? await clientApi.rechercherParCin(numero.trim()) : null;
      if (!found) { setIntrouvable(true); return; }
      setClient(found);
      setContrats(await contratApi.listerParClient(found.id));
    } finally { setRecherche(false); }
  }

  const recherchePossible = Boolean(codeCb.trim() || codeEtablissement.trim() || numero.trim());

  return (
    <div className="mx-auto max-w-5xl space-y-6 p-6">
      <Card>
        <CardHeader><CardTitle>Suivi client — Recherche par identifiant</CardTitle></CardHeader>
        <CardContent className="grid grid-cols-1 items-end gap-4 md:grid-cols-2">
          <div className="space-y-1.5"><Label>Code Client CB</Label><Input value={codeCb} onChange={(e) => setCodeCb(e.target.value)} /></div>
          <div className="space-y-1.5"><Label>Code Client CECAM</Label><Input value={codeEtablissement} onChange={(e) => setCodeEtablissement(e.target.value)} /></div>
          <div className="space-y-1.5"><Label>CIN</Label><Input value={numero} onChange={(e) => setNumero(e.target.value)} /></div>
          <Button onClick={rechercher} disabled={!recherchePossible || recherche}>{recherche ? "Recherche…" : "Rechercher"}</Button>
        </CardContent>
      </Card>

      {introuvable && <p className="text-base text-slate-600">Aucun client trouvé avec cet identifiant.</p>}
      {client && (
        <Card>
          <CardHeader><CardTitle>{client.prenom} {client.nom} — {client.codeClientCb}</CardTitle></CardHeader>
          <CardContent className="space-y-3">
            <p className="text-base text-slate-600">{contrats.length} contrat(s) dans son historique :</p>
            {contrats.map((c) => (
              <Link key={c.id} to={`/demande/rapport/${c.id}`} className="flex items-center justify-between rounded-md border p-4 text-base hover:bg-slate-50">
                <span>{c.codeContratCb} — {c.typeContrat}</span><span className="text-slate-500">{c.phaseDemande}</span>
              </Link>
            ))}
          </CardContent>
        </Card>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

File: bic-frontend/src/types/contrat.ts

export type ModeRattachement = "NOUVELLE_DEMANDE" | "DEMANDE_EXISTANTE";
export type RoleClient = "TITULAIRE" | "CO_TITULAIRE" | "GARANT";
export type PhaseDemande = "DEMANDE_EN_COURS" | "ACTIF" | "REFUSE" | "FERME" | "ABANDONNE";
export type MotifCloture = "FIN_A_TERME" | "FIN_ANTICIPEE";

export interface ContratRequest {
  clientId: number;
  modeRattachement: ModeRattachement;
  typeContrat: string;
  roleClient: RoleClient;
  dateDemande: string;
  montantFinance: number;
  montantEcheanceMensuelle?: number;
  nombreTotalEcheances: number;
  devise: string;
  periodicitePaiement?: string;
}

export type ContratResponse = Omit<ContratRequest, "montantEcheanceMensuelle" | "devise"> & {
  id: number;
  codeContratCb: string;
  phaseDemande: string;
  codeContratEtablissement?: string | null;
  codeDemandeEtablissement?: string | null;
  montantEcheanceMensuelle?: number | null;
  devise?: string | null;
  motifCloture?: MotifCloture | null;
  client?: { prenom: string; nom: string; codeClientCb?: string };
};

// HTML-escape helper — prevents XSS when injecting graph data into innerHTML
function esc(s) {
  return String(s).replace(/&/g,'&amp;').replace(/</g,'&lt;').replace(/>/g,'&gt;').replace(/"/g,'&quot;').replace(/'/g,'&#39;');
}

// Build vis datasets
const nodesDS = new vis.DataSet(RAW_NODES.map((n, i) => ({
  id: n.id, label: n.label, color: n.color, size: n.size,
  font: n.font, title: n.title,
  // Fermat/golden-angle spiral seed positions (#3699): spreading nodes out
  // before physics runs keeps avoidOverlap from computing near-zero-distance
  // repulsion that blows the BarnesHut recursion into a stack overflow on large
  // graphs. `i` is the map index — physics still settles small graphs identically.
  x: 30 * Math.sqrt(i) * Math.cos(i * 2.4),
  y: 30 * Math.sqrt(i) * Math.sin(i * 2.4),
  community: n.community, community_name: n.community_name,
  source_file: n.source_file, file_type: n.file_type, degree: n.degree,
  member_count: n.member_count,
})));

const edgesDS = new vis.DataSet(RAW_EDGES.map((e, i) => ({
  id: i, from: e.from, to: e.to,
  label: '',
  title: e.title,
  dashes: e.dashes,
  width: e.width,
  color: e.color,
  arrows: { to: { enabled: true, scaleFactor: 0.5 } },
})));

const container = document.getElementById('graph');
const network = new vis.Network(container, { nodes: nodesDS, edges: edgesDS }, {
  physics: {
    enabled: true,
    solver: 'forceAtlas2Based',
    forceAtlas2Based: {
      gravitationalConstant: -60,
      centralGravity: 0.005,
      springLength: 120,
      springConstant: 0.08,
      damping: 0.4,
      avoidOverlap: 0.8,
    },
    stabilization: { iterations: 200, fit: true },
  },
  interaction: {
    hover: true,
    tooltipDelay: 100,
    hideEdgesOnDrag: true,
    navigationButtons: false,
    keyboard: false,
  },
  nodes: { shape: 'dot', borderWidth: 1.5 },
  edges: { smooth: { type: 'continuous', roundness: 0.2 }, selectionWidth: 3 },
});

network.once('stabilizationIterationsDone', () => {
  network.setOptions({ physics: { enabled: false } });
});

function showInfo(nodeId) {
  const n = nodesDS.get(nodeId);
  if (!n) return;
  const neighborIds = network.getConnectedNodes(nodeId);
  const neighborItems = neighborIds.map(nid => {
    const nb = nodesDS.get(nid);
    const color = nb ? nb.color.background : '#555';
    return `<span class="neighbor-link" style="border-left-color:${esc(color)}" data-nid="${esc(nid)}">${esc(nb ? nb.label : nid)}</span>`;
  }).join('');
  const isMetaNode = !n.file_type && !n.source_file;
  let html = `<div class="field"><b>${esc(n.label)}</b></div>`;
  if (!isMetaNode) {
    html += `<div class="field">Type: ${esc(n.file_type || 'unknown')}</div>`;
  }
  html += `<div class="field">Community: ${esc(n.community_name || '')}</div>`;
  if (!isMetaNode) {
    html += `<div class="field">Source: ${esc(n.source_file || '-')}</div>`;
  } else if (n.member_count !== undefined && n.member_count !== null) {
    html += `<div class="field">Members: ${esc(n.member_count)}</div>`;
  }
  html += `<div class="field">Degree: ${n.degree}</div>`;
  if (neighborIds.length) {
    html += `<div class="field" style="margin-top:8px;color:#aaa;font-size:11px">Neighbors (${neighborIds.length})</div><div id="neighbors-list">${neighborItems}</div>`;
  }
  document.getElementById('info-content').innerHTML = html;
}

function focusNode(nodeId) {
  network.focus(nodeId, { scale: 1.4, animation: true });
  network.selectNodes([nodeId]);
  showInfo(nodeId);
}

// Neighbor links use a data attribute + one delegated listener rather than an
// inline onclick. A node id/label sourced from a document or a scraped URL
// (graphify add) can contain a double-quote; dropping the stringified id
// unescaped into a quoted onclick both broke every link and allowed a hostile
// source to inject an event handler into the local report (stored XSS, #1838).
// esc() on data-nid keeps the value inside the attribute; the listener reads it
// back verbatim. Bound to document so it survives the innerHTML rebuild that
// recreates #neighbors-list on each showInfo().
document.addEventListener('click', e => {
  const el = e.target.closest('.neighbor-link');
  if (el && el.dataset.nid !== undefined) focusNode(el.dataset.nid);
});

// Track hovered node — hover detection is more reliable than click params
let hoveredNodeId = null;
network.on('hoverNode', params => {
  hoveredNodeId = params.node;
  container.style.cursor = 'pointer';
});
network.on('blurNode', () => {
  hoveredNodeId = null;
  container.style.cursor = 'default';
});
container.addEventListener('click', () => {
  if (hoveredNodeId !== null) {
    showInfo(hoveredNodeId);
    network.selectNodes([hoveredNodeId]);
  }
});
network.on('click', params => {
  if (params.nodes.length > 0) {
    showInfo(params.nodes[0]);
  } else if (hoveredNodeId === null) {
    document.getElementById('info-content').innerHTML = '<span class="empty">Click a node to inspect it</span>';
  }
});

const searchInput = document.getElementById('search');
const searchResults = document.getElementById('search-results');
searchInput.addEventListener('input', () => {
  const q = searchInput.value.toLowerCase().trim();
  searchResults.innerHTML = '';
  if (!q) { searchResults.style.display = 'none'; return; }
  const matches = RAW_NODES.filter(n => n.label.toLowerCase().includes(q)).slice(0, 20);
  if (!matches.length) { searchResults.style.display = 'none'; return; }
  searchResults.style.display = 'block';
  matches.forEach(n => {
    const el = document.createElement('div');
    el.className = 'search-item';
    el.textContent = n.label;
    el.style.borderLeft = `3px solid ${n.color.background}`;
    el.style.paddingLeft = '8px';
    el.onclick = () => {
      network.focus(n.id, { scale: 1.5, animation: true });
      network.selectNodes([n.id]);
      showInfo(n.id);
      searchResults.style.display = 'none';
      searchInput.value = '';
    };
    searchResults.appendChild(el);
  });
});
document.addEventListener('click', e => {
  if (!searchResults.contains(e.target) && e.target !== searchInput)
    searchResults.style.display = 'none';
});

const hiddenCommunities = new Set();

const selectAllCb = document.getElementById('select-all-cb');

function updateSelectAllState() {
  const total = LEGEND.length;
  const hidden = hiddenCommunities.size;
  selectAllCb.checked = hidden === 0;
  selectAllCb.indeterminate = hidden > 0 && hidden < total;
}

function toggleAllCommunities(hide) {
  document.querySelectorAll('.legend-item').forEach(item => {
    hide ? item.classList.add('dimmed') : item.classList.remove('dimmed');
  });
  document.querySelectorAll('.legend-cb').forEach(cb => {
    cb.checked = !hide;
  });
  LEGEND.forEach(c => {
    if (hide) hiddenCommunities.add(c.cid); else hiddenCommunities.delete(c.cid);
  });
  const updates = RAW_NODES.map(n => ({ id: n.id, hidden: hide }));
  nodesDS.update(updates);
  updateSelectAllState();
}

const legendEl = document.getElementById('legend');
LEGEND.forEach(c => {
  const item = document.createElement('div');
  item.className = 'legend-item';
  const cb = document.createElement('input');
  cb.type = 'checkbox';
  cb.className = 'legend-cb';
  cb.checked = true;
  cb.addEventListener('change', (e) => {
    e.stopPropagation();
    if (cb.checked) {
      hiddenCommunities.delete(c.cid);
      item.classList.remove('dimmed');
    } else {
      hiddenCommunities.add(c.cid);
      item.classList.add('dimmed');
    }
    const updates = RAW_NODES
      .filter(n => n.community === c.cid)
      .map(n => ({ id: n.id, hidden: !cb.checked }));
    nodesDS.update(updates);
    updateSelectAllState();
  });
  item.innerHTML = `<div class="legend-dot" style="background:${c.color}"></div>
    <span class="legend-label">${c.label}</span>
    <span class="legend-count">${c.count}</span>`;
  item.prepend(cb);
  item.onclick = (e) => {
    if (e.target === cb) return;
    cb.checked = !cb.checked;
    cb.dispatchEvent(new Event('change'));
  };
  legendEl.appendChild(item);
});

<script>
// Render hyperedges as shaded regions
const hyperedges = [];
// afterDrawing passes ctx already transformed to network coordinate space.
// Draw node positions raw — no manual pan/zoom/DPR math needed.

// Andrew's monotone chain. Returns the hull in counter-clockwise order, which
// is what the perimeter must be traced in. Collinear and duplicate points
// collapse to the extremes, so degenerate member sets render as a segment
// rather than a zero-area crossed path.
function convexHull(pts) {
    const p = pts.slice().sort((a, b) => (a.x - b.x) || (a.y - b.y));
    if (p.length < 3) return p;
    const cross = (o, a, b) => (a.x - o.x) * (b.y - o.y) - (a.y - o.y) * (b.x - o.x);
    const build = seq => {
        const out = [];
        for (const q of seq) {
            while (out.length >= 2 && cross(out[out.length - 2], out[out.length - 1], q) <= 0) out.pop();
            out.push(q);
        }
        out.pop();
        return out;
    };
    const hull = build(p).concat(build(p.slice().reverse()));
    return hull.length >= 3 ? hull : p;
}
network.on('afterDrawing', function(ctx) {
    hyperedges.forEach(h => {
        const positions = h.nodes
            .map(nid => network.getPositions([nid])[nid])
            .filter(p => p !== undefined);
        if (positions.length < 2) return;
        ctx.save();
        ctx.globalAlpha = 0.12;
        ctx.fillStyle = '#6366f1';
        ctx.strokeStyle = '#6366f1';
        ctx.lineWidth = 2;
        ctx.beginPath();
        // Centroid and expanded hull in network coordinates.
        // The perimeter must follow hull order, not h.nodes order: tracing the
        // raw member order self-intersects whenever the layout does not happen
        // to place members in angular order, filling as crossed wedges.
        const cx = positions.reduce((s, p) => s + p.x, 0) / positions.length;
        const cy = positions.reduce((s, p) => s + p.y, 0) / positions.length;
        const hull = convexHull(positions);
        const expanded = hull.map(p => ({
            x: cx + (p.x - cx) * 1.15,
            y: cy + (p.y - cy) * 1.15
        }));
        ctx.moveTo(expanded[0].x, expanded[0].y);
        expanded.slice(1).forEach(p => ctx.lineTo(p.x, p.y));
        ctx.closePath();
        ctx.fill();
        ctx.globalAlpha = 0.4;
        ctx.stroke();
        // Label
        ctx.globalAlpha = 0.8;
        ctx.fillStyle = '#4f46e5';
        ctx.font = 'bold 11px sans-serif';
        ctx.textAlign = 'center';
        ctx.fillText(h.label, cx, cy - 5);
        ctx.restore();
    });
});
</script>

package mg.cecam.bic.client;

import jakarta.validation.Valid;
import lombok.RequiredArgsConstructor;
import mg.cecam.bic.client.dto.ClientEnregistrementResponse;
import mg.cecam.bic.client.dto.ClientRequest;
import mg.cecam.bic.client.dto.ClientResponse;
import org.springframework.http.HttpStatus;
import org.springframework.http.ResponseEntity;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.*;
import org.springframework.web.server.ResponseStatusException;

@RestController
@RequestMapping("/api/clients")
@RequiredArgsConstructor
public class ClientController {

    private final ClientService clientService;
    private final ClientRepository clientRepository;

    @PutMapping("/{id}")
    public ResponseEntity<Client> mettreAJour(@PathVariable Long id, @Valid @RequestBody ClientRequest request) {
        return ResponseEntity.ok(clientService.mettreAJour(id, request));
    }

    @PostMapping("/{id}/adresses")
    public ResponseEntity<Adresse> ajouterAdresse(@PathVariable Long id, @RequestBody ClientRequest.AdresseRequest request) {
        return ResponseEntity.status(HttpStatus.CREATED).body(clientService.ajouterAdresse(id, request));
    }

    @PostMapping
    public ResponseEntity<ClientEnregistrementResponse> creer(@Valid @RequestBody ClientRequest request) {
        ClientEnregistrementResponse result = clientService.enregistrerOuRecuperer(request);
        return ResponseEntity.status(result.clientTrouve() ? HttpStatus.OK : HttpStatus.CREATED).body(result);
    }

    @GetMapping("/recherche")
    public ResponseEntity<Client> rechercher(
            @RequestParam(required = false) String typeIdentifiant,
            @RequestParam(required = false) String numero,
            @RequestParam(required = false) String codeClientCb,
            @RequestParam(required = false) String codeClientEtablissement) {
        Client client = null;
        if (codeClientCb != null && !codeClientCb.isBlank()) {
            client = clientRepository.findByCodeClientCb(codeClientCb).orElse(null);
        } else if (codeClientEtablissement != null && !codeClientEtablissement.isBlank()) {
            client = clientRepository.findByCodeClientEtablissement(codeClientEtablissement).orElse(null);
        } else if (typeIdentifiant != null && numero != null) {
            client = clientService.rechercherParIdentifiant(typeIdentifiant, numero);
        }
        return client == null ? ResponseEntity.notFound().build() : ResponseEntity.ok(client);
    }

    public ResponseEntity<ClientResponse> obtenir(@PathVariable Long id) {
        Client client = clientRepository.findById(id)
                .orElseThrow(() -> new ResponseStatusException(HttpStatus.NOT_FOUND, "Client introuvable"));

        ClientResponse response = new ClientResponse(
                client.getId(),
                client.getCodeClientCb(),
                client.getTitre(),
                client.getCategorieTiersCode(),
                client.getPrenom(),
                client.getDeuxiemePrenom(),
                client.getNom(),
                client.getDateNaissance(),
                client.getVilleNaissance(),
                client.getPaysNaissance(),
                client.getGenre(),
                client.getNationalite(),
                client.getEtatCivil()
        );

        return ResponseEntity.ok(response);
    }
}

package mg.cecam.bic.common.util;

import mg.cecam.bic.common.enums.MotifCloture;
import mg.cecam.bic.common.enums.PhaseDemande;
import mg.cecam.bic.common.enums.RoleClient;
import mg.cecam.bic.common.enums.StatutEcheance;

import java.text.Normalizer;

public final class LabelMapper {
    private LabelMapper() {}

    public static String role(RoleClient r) {
        if (r == null) return "-";
        return switch (r) {
            case TITULAIRE -> "Titulaire";
            case CO_TITULAIRE -> "Co-Titulaire";
            case GARANT -> "Garant";
        };
    }

    public static String phase(PhaseDemande p) {
        return phase(p, null);
    }

    public static String phase(PhaseDemande p, MotifCloture motif) {
        if (p == null) return "-";
        return switch (p) {
            case DEMANDE_EN_COURS -> "Demande en cours";
            case ACTIF -> "Actif";
            case REFUSE -> "Refusé";
            case ABANDONNE -> "Abandonné";
            case FERME -> motif == MotifCloture.FIN_ANTICIPEE ? "Fin Anticipée" : "Fin à terme";
        };
    }

    public static String statutEcheance(StatutEcheance s) {
        if (s == null) return "-";
        return switch (s) {
            case PAYE_A_TEMPS -> "Payé à temps";
            case EN_RETARD -> "En retard";
            case IMPAYE -> "Impayé";
            case A_VENIR -> "À venir";
        };
    }

    public static String codeGrille(StatutEcheance s) {
        if (s == null) return "";
        return switch (s) {
            case PAYE_A_TEMPS -> "OK";
            case EN_RETARD -> "R";
            case IMPAYE -> "IMP";
            case A_VENIR -> "";
        };
    }

    public static String codeGrilleCrif(String statut, Integer jours) {
        String s = normaliser(statut);
        if (!s.isEmpty()) {
            if (s.equals("NOUV") || s.contains("RECENT")) return "NOUV";
            if (s.equals("NDIS") || s.contains("NON DISPONIBLE") || s.contains("INDISPONIBLE")) return "NDIS";
            if (s.contains("180")) return "180+";
            if (s.contains("150")) return "150+";
            if (s.contains("120")) return "120+";
            if (s.contains("90")) return "90+";
            if (s.contains("60")) return "60+";
            if (s.contains("30")) return "30+";
            if (s.contains("1-29") || s.contains("1 - 29")) return "1-29";
            if (s.equals("OK") || s.contains("PAYE A TEMPS") || s.equals("A TEMPS")) return "OK";
        }
        if (jours != null) {
            if (jours <= 0) return "NDIS";
            if (jours < 30) return "1-29";
            if (jours < 60) return "30+";
            if (jours < 90) return "60+";
            if (jours < 120) return "90+";
            if (jours < 150) return "120+";
            if (jours < 180) return "150+";
            return "180+";
        }
        if (s.contains("RETARD") || s.contains("IMPAYE")) return "NDIS";
        return "";
    }

    public static String libelleJoursRetardCrif(Integer jours, String statut) {
        String s = normaliser(statut);
        if (!s.isEmpty()) {
            if (s.equals("NOUV") || s.contains("RECENT")) return "Trop récent";
            if (s.equals("NDIS") || s.contains("NON DISPONIBLE") || s.contains("INDISPONIBLE")) return "-";
            if (s.contains("180")) return "Plus de 180 jours de retard";
            if (s.contains("150")) return "150-179 jours de retard";
            if (s.contains("120")) return "120-149 jours de retard";
            if (s.contains("90")) return "90-119 jours de retard";
            if (s.contains("60")) return "60-89 jours de retard";
            if (s.contains("30")) return "30-59 jours de retard";
            if (s.contains("1-29") || s.contains("1 - 29")) return "1-29 jours de retard";
            if (s.equals("OK") || s.contains("PAYE A TEMPS") || s.equals("A TEMPS")) return "Payé à temps";
        }
        if (jours != null) {
            if (jours <= 0) return "0 jour de retard";
            if (jours < 30) return "1-29 jours de retard";
            if (jours < 60) return "30-59 jours de retard";
            if (jours < 90) return "60-89 jours de retard";
            if (jours < 120) return "90-119 jours de retard";
            if (jours < 150) return "120-149 jours de retard";
            if (jours < 180) return "150-179 jours de retard";
            return "Plus de 180 jours de retard";
        }
        return "-";
    }

    private static String normaliser(String valeur) {
        if (valeur == null || valeur.isBlank()) return "";
        return Normalizer.normalize(valeur.trim().toUpperCase(), Normalizer.Form.NFD)
                .replaceAll("\\p{M}", "")
                .replace('–', '-')
                .replace('−', '-')
                .replaceAll("\\s+", " ");
    }

    public static String couleurCodeCrif(String code) {
        if (code == null) return "#FFFFFF";
        return switch (code) {
            case "OK" -> "#C8E6C9";
            case "NOUV", "NDIS", "-" -> "#FFFFFF";
            case "1-29" -> "#FFF59D";
            case "30+" -> "#FFE082";
            case "60+" -> "#FFB74D";
            case "90+" -> "#FF8A65";
            case "120+" -> "#FF7043";
            case "150+" -> "#EF5350";
            case "180+" -> "#E53935";
            default -> "#FFFFFF";
        };
    }
}

================
File: bic-frontend/src/api/contratApi.ts
================
import { axiosClient } from "./axiosClient";
import type { ContratRequest, ContratResponse } from "@/types/contrat";

export const contratApi = {
  creer: async (payload: ContratRequest): Promise<ContratResponse> => {
    const { data } = await axiosClient.post<ContratResponse>("/contrats", payload);
    return data;
  },
  listerParClient: async (clientId: number) => {
  const { data } = await axiosClient.get<import("@/types/contrat").ContratResponse[]>("/contrats", { params: { clientId } });
  return data;
},
rechercherParIdentifiant: async (code: string): Promise<ContratResponse | null> => {
  try {
    const { data } = await axiosClient.get<ContratResponse>("/contrats/recherche", { params: { identifiantContrat: code } });
    return data;
  } catch {
    return null;
  }
},
changerPhase: async (contratId: number, phase: string, motif?: string) => {
  const { data } = await axiosClient.patch(`/contrats/${contratId}/phase`, { phase, motif: motif || null });
  return data;
},
changerEcheanceMensuelle: async (contratId: number, montantEcheanceMensuelle: number | null, devise: string) => {
  await axiosClient.patch(`/contrats/${contratId}/echeance-mensuelle`, { montantEcheanceMensuelle, devise });
},
changerCodesEtablissement: async (contratId: number, codeContratEtablissement: string, codeDemandeEtablissement: string) => {
  await axiosClient.patch(`/contrats/${contratId}/codes-etablissement`, { codeContratEtablissement, codeDemandeEtablissement });
},

import { useState } from "react";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { Card, CardContent, CardHeader, CardTitle } from "@/components/ui/card";
import { clientApi } from "@/api/clientApi";
import type { ClientRequest } from "@/types/client";
import { useToast } from "@/hooks/use-toast";

const ENTETES = ["prenom", "nom", "dateNaissance", "genre", "numeroIdentifiant", "adresseComplete", "ville", "commune", "region", "telephone", "codeClientEtablissement", "nationalite", "pays"];
const ENTETES_REQUISES = ["prenom", "nom", "dateNaissance", "genre", "numeroIdentifiant", "adresseComplete"];

type CsvRow = Record<string, string>;

function analyserCsv(text: string): CsvRow[] {
  let compteurVirgules = 0, compteurPointsVirgules = 0, guillemetsEntete = false;
  for (let i = 0; i < text.length && text[i] !== "\n" && text[i] !== "\r"; i++) {
    if (text[i] === '"' && text[i + 1] === '"' && guillemetsEntete) i++;
    else if (text[i] === '"') guillemetsEntete = !guillemetsEntete;
    else if (!guillemetsEntete && text[i] === ",") compteurVirgules++;
    else if (!guillemetsEntete && text[i] === ";") compteurPointsVirgules++;
  }
  const separateur = compteurPointsVirgules >= compteurVirgules ? ";" : ",";
  const lignes: string[][] = [];
  let ligne: string[] = [], cellule = "", guillemets = false;
  for (let i = 0; i < text.length; i++) {
    const c = text[i];
    if (c === '"' && guillemets && text[i + 1] === '"') { cellule += '"'; i++; }
    else if (c === '"') guillemets = !guillemets;
    else if (!guillemets && c === separateur) { ligne.push(cellule.trim()); cellule = ""; }
    else if (!guillemets && (c === "\n" || c === "\r")) {
      if (c === "\r" && text[i + 1] === "\n") i++;
      ligne.push(cellule.trim());
      if (ligne.some((v) => v !== "")) lignes.push(ligne);
      ligne = []; cellule = "";
    } else cellule += c;
  }
  ligne.push(cellule.trim());
  if (ligne.some((v) => v !== "")) lignes.push(ligne);
  if (guillemets || lignes.length < 1) throw new Error("Le CSV est vide ou mal formé.");
  const entetes = lignes[0].map((h) => h.replace(/^﻿/, "").trim());
  if (!entetes.length || entetes.some((h) => !h) || new Set(entetes).size !== entetes.length) throw new Error("Les en-têtes CSV sont vides ou dupliqués.");
  const manquantes = ENTETES_REQUISES.filter((h) => !entetes.includes(h));
  if (manquantes.length) throw new Error(`Colonnes manquantes : ${manquantes.join(", ")}`);
  const ligneTropLarge = lignes.slice(1).findIndex((values) => values.slice(entetes.length).some((v) => v !== ""));
  if (ligneTropLarge >= 0) throw new Error(`La ligne ${ligneTropLarge + 2} contient plus de colonnes que l'en-tête.`);
  return lignes.slice(1).map((values) => Object.fromEntries(entetes.map((h, i) => [h, values[i] ?? ""])));
}

function dateIso(raw: string): string {
  const value = raw.trim();
  const iso = /^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/.test(value) ? value : (() => {
    const m = /^(\d{1,2})\/(\d{1,2})\/(\d{4})$/.exec(value);
    if (!m) throw new Error("dateNaissance doit être au format jj/mm/aaaa ou aaaa-mm-jj");
    return `${m[3]}-${m[2].padStart(2, "0")}-${m[1].padStart(2, "0")}`;
  })();
  const parsed = new Date(`${iso}T00:00:00Z`);
  if (Number.isNaN(parsed.getTime()) || parsed.toISOString().slice(0, 10) !== iso) throw new Error("dateNaissance n'est pas une date valide");
  return iso;
}

function clientDepuisCsv(row: CsvRow): ClientRequest {
  const prenom = row.prenom?.trim(), nom = row.nom?.trim(), cin = row.numeroIdentifiant?.trim();
  const genre = row.genre?.trim().toUpperCase();
  if (!prenom || !nom || !cin || !row.adresseComplete?.trim()) throw new Error("Une ligne ne contient pas le prénom, le nom, le CIN ou l'adresse complète requis.");
  if (genre !== "HOMME" && genre !== "FEMME") throw new Error("genre doit être HOMME ou FEMME");
  return {
    categorieTiersCode: "0004",
    prenom, nom, dateNaissance: dateIso(row.dateNaissance ?? ""), genre,
    nationalite: row.nationalite?.trim() || "Malgache",
    codeClientEtablissement: row.codeClientEtablissement?.trim() || undefined,
    telephone: row.telephone?.trim() || undefined,
    identifiants: [{ typeIdentifiant: "CIN", numero: cin }],
    adresses: [{ typeAdresse: row.typeAdresse?.trim() || "Individu - Adresse principale",
      adresseComplete: row.adresseComplete.trim(), ville: row.ville?.trim(), commune: row.commune?.trim(),
      region: row.region?.trim(), pays: row.pays?.trim() || "Madagascar" }],
  };
}

export function ImportPage() {
  const { toast } = useToast();
  const [rows, setRows] = useState<CsvRow[]>([]);
  const [nomFichier, setNomFichier] = useState("");
  const [chargement, setChargement] = useState(false);
  const [resultat, setResultat] = useState<{ crees: number; existants: number; erreurs: { ligne: number; message: string }[] } | null>(null);

  async function chargerFichier(file?: File) {
    setRows([]); setResultat(null); setNomFichier(file?.name ?? "");
    if (!file) return;
    try { setRows(analyserCsv(await file.text())); }
    catch (error) { setNomFichier(""); toast({ title: error instanceof Error ? error.message : "CSV invalide", variant: "destructive" }); }
  }

  async function importer() {
    setChargement(true); setResultat(null);
    let crees = 0, existants = 0;
    const erreurs: { ligne: number; message: string }[] = [];
    for (const [index, row] of rows.entries()) {
      try {
        const payload = clientDepuisCsv(row);
        try {
          const response = await clientApi.creer(payload);
          if (response.clientTrouve) existants++; else crees++;
        } catch {
          erreurs.push({ ligne: index + 2, message: "Enregistrement refusé par le serveur. Vérifiez les informations de cette ligne." });
        }
      } catch (error) {
        erreurs.push({ ligne: index + 2, message: error instanceof Error ? error.message : "Ligne invalide." });
      }
    }
    setResultat({ crees, existants, erreurs });
    toast({ title: erreurs.length ? `Import terminé avec ${erreurs.length} ligne(s) à corriger.` : `Import terminé — ${crees} créé(s), ${existants} déjà présent(s).`, variant: erreurs.length ? "destructive" : undefined });
    setChargement(false);
  }

  function telechargerModele() {
    const contenu = `${ENTETES.join(";")}\n`;
    const url = URL.createObjectURL(new Blob([contenu], { type: "text/csv;charset=utf-8" }));
    const a = document.createElement("a"); a.href = url; a.download = "modele-import-clients.csv"; a.click();
    window.setTimeout(() => URL.revokeObjectURL(url), 10_000);
  }

  return <div className="mx-auto max-w-5xl space-y-6 p-6">
    <Card><CardHeader><CardTitle>Importation de clients — CSV</CardTitle></CardHeader>
      <CardContent className="space-y-4 text-base">
        <p>Import réservé à l’administrateur. Le fichier reste dans le navigateur ; les clients existants identifiés par CIN ne sont pas recréés.</p>
        <p>Colonnes obligatoires : {ENTETES_REQUISES.join(" ; ")}. Téléphone, Code Client CECAM, nationalité et pays facultatifs. Séparateur accepté : point-virgule ou virgule. Aucun fichier contenant des mots de passe ou jetons n’est accepté.</p>
        <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-3"><Button type="button" variant="outline" onClick={telechargerModele}>Télécharger le modèle CSV</Button>
          <input type="file" accept=".csv,text/csv" onChange={(e) => void chargerFichier(e.target.files?.[0])} /></div>
        {nomFichier && <p>{nomFichier} — {rows.length} ligne(s) prête(s) à importer.</p>}
        {rows.length > 0 && <Button onClick={() => void importer()} disabled={chargement}>{chargement ? "Import en cours…" : `Importer ${rows.length} client(s)`}</Button>}
        {resultat && <div className="space-y-2 text-base">
          <p className="font-semibold">Créés : {resultat.crees} · Déjà présents : {resultat.existants} · Erreurs : {resultat.erreurs.length}</p>
          {resultat.erreurs.length > 0 && <div role="alert" className="rounded-lg border border-red-200 bg-red-50 p-4 text-red-900">
            <p>Les lignes indiquées n’ont pas été importées. Les autres lignes ont été traitées ; corrigez les erreurs puis relancez l’import.</p>
            <ul className="mt-2 list-inside list-disc">{resultat.erreurs.map((erreur) => <li key={erreur.ligne}>Ligne {erreur.ligne} : {erreur.message}</li>)}</ul>
          </div>}
        </div>}
      </CardContent>
    </Card>
  </div>;
}

package mg.cecam.bic.rapport;

import lombok.RequiredArgsConstructor;
import mg.cecam.bic.common.enums.StatutEcheance;
import mg.cecam.bic.common.util.LabelMapper;
import mg.cecam.bic.common.util.MontantFormatUtil;
import mg.cecam.bic.contrat.Contrat;
import mg.cecam.bic.contrat.Echeance;
import mg.cecam.bic.contrat.HistoriquePaiementMensuel;
import mg.cecam.bic.rapport.dto.CelluleMoisDTO;
import mg.cecam.bic.rapport.dto.EncoursCategorieDTO;
import mg.cecam.bic.rapport.dto.LigneAnneeDTO;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;

import java.math.BigDecimal;
import java.time.LocalDate;
import java.time.YearMonth;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.Comparator;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.Objects;
import java.util.function.Function;
import java.util.stream.Collectors;

@Service
@RequiredArgsConstructor
public class CalendrierService {

    private static final String[] MOIS =
            {"JAN", "FÉV", "MARS", "AVR", "MAI", "JUIN", "JUILL", "AOÛT", "SEP", "OCT", "NOV", "DÉC"};

    private static final String VERT   = "#C8E6C9";
    private static final String ORANGE = "#FFE0B2";
    private static final String ROUGE  = "#FFCDD2";
    private static final String GRIS   = "#E8E8E4";   

    public List<LigneAnneeDTO> grilleStatut(Contrat contrat, List<Echeance> echeances, LocalDate reference) {
        return grilleStatut(contrat, echeances, List.of(), reference);
    }

    public List<LigneAnneeDTO> grilleStatut(Contrat contrat, List<Echeance> echeances,
                                            List<HistoriquePaiementMensuel> historiques, LocalDate reference) {
        YearMonth debut = moisDebutDeclaration(contrat, historiques);
        YearMonth fin = moisFinDeclaration(contrat, historiques, reference);
        if (debut == null || fin == null || debut.isAfter(fin)) return List.of();

        Map<YearMonth, HistoriquePaiementMensuel> mapHisto = (historiques == null) ? Map.of() :
                historiques.stream().collect(Collectors.toMap(h -> YearMonth.from(h.getMois()), Function.identity(), (a, b) -> a));

        List<LigneAnneeDTO> lignes = new ArrayList<>();
        for (int annee = debut.getYear(); annee <= fin.getYear(); annee++) {
            List<CelluleMoisDTO> cellules = new ArrayList<>(12);
            for (int m = 1; m <= 12; m++) {
                YearMonth courant = YearMonth.of(annee, m);
                if (courant.isBefore(debut) || courant.isAfter(fin)) {
                    cellules.add(CelluleMoisDTO.vide(MOIS[m - 1]));
                    continue;
                }

                if (!mapHisto.isEmpty() && mapHisto.containsKey(courant)) {
                    HistoriquePaiementMensuel h = mapHisto.get(courant);
                    String code = LabelMapper.codeGrilleCrif(h.getStatut(), h.getJoursDeRetard());
                    String color = LabelMapper.couleurCodeCrif(code);
                    cellules.add(new CelluleMoisDTO(MOIS[m - 1], true, null, code, code, color));
                } else {
                    boolean echeanceObservee = aEcheanceEchue(echeances, courant, reference);
                    Integer maxJours = maxRetardAuMois(echeances, courant, reference);
                    StatutEcheance statut = statutAuMois(echeances, courant, reference);
                    String code = !echeanceObservee ? "NOUV"
                            : statut == null ? "NDIS"
                            : statut == StatutEcheance.PAYE_A_TEMPS ? "OK"
                            : maxJours != null && maxJours > 0 ? LabelMapper.codeGrilleCrif(null, maxJours) : "NDIS";
                    String color = LabelMapper.couleurCodeCrif(code);
                    cellules.add(new CelluleMoisDTO(MOIS[m - 1], true, null,
                            !echeanceObservee ? "NOUV" : statut == null ? "NDIS" : statut.name(), code, color));
                }
            }
            lignes.add(new LigneAnneeDTO(annee, cellules));
        }
        return lignes;
    }

    private Integer maxRetardAuMois(List<Echeance> echeances, YearMonth mois, LocalDate reference) {
        LocalDate dateObservation = dateObservation(mois, reference);
        List<Echeance> dues = echeances.stream()
                .filter(e -> e != null && e.getDateEcheance() != null)
                .filter(e -> !e.getDateEcheance().isAfter(dateObservation))
                .toList();
        if (dues.isEmpty()) return 0;
        List<Integer> retards = dues.stream().map(e -> joursDeRetardObserve(e, dateObservation)).toList();
        if (retards.stream().anyMatch(Objects::isNull)) return null;
        return retards.stream().mapToInt(Integer::intValue).max().orElse(0);
    }

    private StatutEcheance statutAuMois(List<Echeance> echeances, YearMonth mois, LocalDate reference) {
        LocalDate dateObservation = dateObservation(mois, reference);
        StatutEcheance pire = null;
        for (Echeance e : echeances) {
            if (e == null || e.getDateEcheance() == null) continue;
            if (e.getDateEcheance().isAfter(dateObservation)) continue;
            Integer jours = joursDeRetardObserve(e, dateObservation);
            if (jours == null) return null;
            StatutEcheance s;
            if (e.estPayee() && e.getDatePaiement() != null && !e.getDatePaiement().isAfter(dateObservation)) {
                s = jours > 0 ? StatutEcheance.EN_RETARD : StatutEcheance.PAYE_A_TEMPS;
            } else {
                s = jours > Echeance.SEUIL_IMPAYE_JOURS ? StatutEcheance.IMPAYE : StatutEcheance.EN_RETARD;
            }
            if (pire == null || rang(s) > rang(pire)) pire = s;
        }
        return pire;
    }

    private boolean aEcheanceEchue(List<Echeance> echeances, YearMonth mois, LocalDate reference) {
        LocalDate observation = dateObservation(mois, reference);
        return echeances.stream().anyMatch(e -> e != null && e.getDateEcheance() != null
                && !e.getDateEcheance().isAfter(observation));
    }

    private LocalDate dateObservation(YearMonth mois, LocalDate reference) {
        LocalDate finDeMois = mois.atEndOfMonth();
        return finDeMois.isAfter(reference) ? reference : finDeMois;
    }

    private Integer joursDeRetardObserve(Echeance echeance, LocalDate observation) {
        if (echeance.estPayee() && echeance.getDatePaiement() == null) return null;
        LocalDate fin = echeance.estPayee() && !echeance.getDatePaiement().isAfter(observation)
                ? echeance.getDatePaiement() : observation;
        if (!fin.isAfter(echeance.getDateEcheance())) return 0;
        return (int) java.time.temporal.ChronoUnit.DAYS.between(echeance.getDateEcheance(), fin);
    }

    public EncoursCategorieDTO encours(String categorie, String codeEtablissement, String devise,
                                       List<Contrat> contrats,
                                       Map<Long, List<Echeance>> echeancesParContrat,
                                       LocalDate reference) {
        YearMonth debut = null;
        YearMonth fin = null;
        for (Contrat c : contrats) {
            YearMonth d = moisDebutDeclaration(c);
            YearMonth f = moisFinDeclaration(c, reference);
            if (d == null || f == null) continue;
            if (debut == null || d.isBefore(debut)) debut = d;
            if (fin == null || f.isAfter(fin)) fin = f;
        }
        if (debut == null || fin == null) {
            return new EncoursCategorieDTO(categorie, codeEtablissement, devise, List.of());
        }

        List<LigneAnneeDTO> lignes = new ArrayList<>();
        for (int annee = debut.getYear(); annee <= fin.getYear(); annee++) {
            List<CelluleMoisDTO> cellules = new ArrayList<>(12);
            for (int m = 1; m <= 12; m++) {
                YearMonth courant = YearMonth.of(annee, m);
                LocalDate finDeMois = courant.atEndOfMonth();

                boolean declare = false;
                BigDecimal encours = BigDecimal.ZERO;

                for (Contrat c : contrats) {
                    YearMonth d = moisDebutDeclaration(c);
                    YearMonth f = moisFinDeclaration(c, reference);
                    if (d == null || f == null) continue;
                    if (courant.isBefore(d) || courant.isAfter(f)) continue;
                    declare = true;
                    for (Echeance e : echeancesParContrat.getOrDefault(c.getId(), List.of())) {
                        if (e == null || e.getDateEcheance() == null || e.getMontantDu() == null) continue;
                        BigDecimal paye = BigDecimal.ZERO;
                        if (e.getDatePaiement() != null && !e.getDatePaiement().isAfter(finDeMois)) {
                            paye = e.getMontantPaye() == null ? e.getMontantDu() : e.getMontantPaye();
                        } else if (e.getDatePaiement() == null
                                && courant.equals(YearMonth.from(reference)) && e.estPayee()) {
                            paye = e.getMontantPaye() == null ? e.getMontantDu() : e.getMontantPaye();
                        }
                        BigDecimal restant = e.getMontantDu().subtract(paye).max(BigDecimal.ZERO);
                        encours = encours.add(restant);
                    }
                }

                if (!declare) {
                    cellules.add(CelluleMoisDTO.vide(MOIS[m - 1]));
                } else if (encours.signum() == 0) {
                    cellules.add(new CelluleMoisDTO(MOIS[m - 1], true, BigDecimal.ZERO, null, "", GRIS));
                } else {
                    cellules.add(new CelluleMoisDTO(MOIS[m - 1], true, encours, null,
                            MontantFormatUtil.formatMontant(encours), GRIS));
                }
            }
            lignes.add(new LigneAnneeDTO(annee, cellules));
        }
        return new EncoursCategorieDTO(categorie, codeEtablissement, devise, lignes);
    }

    public EncoursCategorieDTO impayes(String categorie, String codeEtablissement, String devise,
                                       List<Contrat> contrats,
                                       Map<Long, List<Echeance>> echeancesParContrat,
                                       LocalDate reference) {
        YearMonth debut = null;
        YearMonth fin = null;
        for (Contrat c : contrats) {
            YearMonth d = moisDebutDeclaration(c);
            YearMonth f = moisFinDeclaration(c, reference);
            if (d == null || f == null) continue;
            if (debut == null || d.isBefore(debut)) debut = d;
            if (fin == null || f.isAfter(fin)) fin = f;
        }
        if (debut == null || fin == null) {
            return new EncoursCategorieDTO(categorie, codeEtablissement, devise, List.of());
        }

        List<LigneAnneeDTO> lignes = new ArrayList<>();
        for (int annee = debut.getYear(); annee <= fin.getYear(); annee++) {
            List<CelluleMoisDTO> cellules = new ArrayList<>(12);
            for (int m = 1; m <= 12; m++) {
                YearMonth courant = YearMonth.of(annee, m);
                LocalDate finDeMois = courant.atEndOfMonth();

                boolean declare = false;
                BigDecimal montantImpayes = BigDecimal.ZERO;

                for (Contrat c : contrats) {
                    YearMonth d = moisDebutDeclaration(c);
                    YearMonth f = moisFinDeclaration(c, reference);
                    if (d == null || f == null) continue;
                    if (courant.isBefore(d) || courant.isAfter(f)) continue;
                    declare = true;
                    for (Echeance e : echeancesParContrat.getOrDefault(c.getId(), List.of())) {
                        if (e == null || e.getDateEcheance() == null || e.getMontantDu() == null) continue;
                        if (e.getDateEcheance().isAfter(finDeMois)) continue;
                        BigDecimal paye = BigDecimal.ZERO;
                        if (e.getDatePaiement() != null && !e.getDatePaiement().isAfter(finDeMois)) {
                            paye = e.getMontantPaye() == null ? e.getMontantDu() : e.getMontantPaye();
                        } else if (e.getDatePaiement() == null
                                && courant.equals(YearMonth.from(reference)) && e.estPayee()) {
                            paye = e.getMontantPaye() == null ? e.getMontantDu() : e.getMontantPaye();
                        }
                        BigDecimal restant = e.getMontantDu().subtract(paye).max(BigDecimal.ZERO);
                        montantImpayes = montantImpayes.add(restant);
                    }
                }

                if (!declare) {
                    cellules.add(CelluleMoisDTO.vide(MOIS[m - 1]));
                } else if (montantImpayes.signum() == 0) {
                    cellules.add(new CelluleMoisDTO(MOIS[m - 1], true, BigDecimal.ZERO, null, "", GRIS));
                } else {
                    cellules.add(new CelluleMoisDTO(MOIS[m - 1], true, montantImpayes, null,
                            MontantFormatUtil.formatMontant(montantImpayes), GRIS));
                }
            }
            lignes.add(new LigneAnneeDTO(annee, cellules));
        }
        return new EncoursCategorieDTO(categorie, codeEtablissement, devise, lignes);
    }

    public YearMonth moisDebutDeclaration(Contrat c) {
        return moisDebutDeclaration(c, List.of());
    }

    public YearMonth moisDebutDeclaration(Contrat c, List<HistoriquePaiementMensuel> historiques) {
        YearMonth minHisto = (historiques == null || historiques.isEmpty()) ? null :
                historiques.stream().map(h -> YearMonth.from(h.getMois())).min(Comparator.naturalOrder()).orElse(null);
        LocalDate debut = c.getDateDebutContrat();
        if (debut == null) debut = c.getDateDemande();
        if (debut == null) return minHisto;
        YearMonth ym = YearMonth.from(debut);
        if (minHisto != null && minHisto.isBefore(ym)) return minHisto;
        return ym;
    }

    public YearMonth moisFinDeclaration(Contrat c, LocalDate reference) {
        return moisFinDeclaration(c, List.of(), reference);
    }

    public YearMonth moisFinDeclaration(Contrat c, List<HistoriquePaiementMensuel> historiques, LocalDate reference) {
        YearMonth maxHisto = (historiques == null || historiques.isEmpty()) ? null :
                historiques.stream().map(h -> YearMonth.from(h.getMois())).max(Comparator.naturalOrder()).orElse(null);
        if (c.getDateDebutContrat() == null && maxHisto != null) return maxHisto;
        if (c.getDateDebutContrat() == null) return null;
        LocalDate borne = reference;
        if (c.getDateDerniereModification() != null) {
            LocalDate derniere = c.getDateDerniereModification().toLocalDate();
            if (derniere.isBefore(borne)) borne = derniere;
        }
        if (c.getDateFinContrat() != null && c.getDateFinContrat().isBefore(borne)) {
            borne = c.getDateFinContrat();
        }
        if (borne.isBefore(c.getDateDebutContrat())) borne = c.getDateDebutContrat();
        YearMonth ym = YearMonth.from(borne);
        if (maxHisto != null && maxHisto.isAfter(ym)) return maxHisto;
        return ym;
    }

    private static int rang(StatutEcheance s) {
        return switch (s) {
            case A_VENIR -> 0;
            case PAYE_A_TEMPS -> 1;
            case EN_RETARD -> 2;
            case IMPAYE -> 3;
        };
    }

    private String couleur(StatutEcheance s) {
        return switch (s) {
            case PAYE_A_TEMPS -> VERT;
            case EN_RETARD -> ORANGE;
            case IMPAYE -> ROUGE;
            case A_VENIR -> GRIS;
        };
    }
}

import { z } from "zod";

export const contratSchema = z.object({
  modeRattachement: z.enum(["NOUVELLE_DEMANDE", "DEMANDE_EXISTANTE"]),
  typeContrat: z.string().min(1),
  codeClientCbCible: z.string().optional(),
  roleClient: z.enum(["TITULAIRE", "CO_TITULAIRE", "GARANT"], { message: "Le rôle client est requis" }),
  dateDemande: z.string().min(1),
  montantFinance: z.coerce.number().positive(),
  montantEcheanceMensuelle: z.coerce.number().optional(),
  nombreTotalEcheances: z.coerce.number().int().positive(),
  devise: z.string().min(1),
  periodicitePaiement: z.string().optional(),
}).refine((v) => v.modeRattachement !== "DEMANDE_EXISTANTE" || !!v.codeClientCbCible, {
  message: "Le code client CB est requis pour ce mode de rattachement",
  path: ["codeClientCbCible"],
});

export type ContratFormValues = z.infer<typeof contratSchema>;
export type ContratFormInput = z.input<typeof contratSchema>;

package mg.cecam.bic.contrat.dto;

import jakarta.validation.constraints.NotNull;
import jakarta.validation.constraints.Positive;
import jakarta.validation.constraints.AssertTrue;
import mg.cecam.bic.common.enums.ModeRattachement;
import mg.cecam.bic.common.enums.RoleClient;

import java.math.BigDecimal;
import java.time.LocalDate;

public record ContratRequest(
        @NotNull Long clientId,
        @NotNull ModeRattachement modeRattachement,
        @NotNull String typeContrat,
        String codeClientCbCible,
        String codeContratEtablissement, 
        @NotNull RoleClient roleClient,
        @NotNull LocalDate dateDemande,
        @NotNull @Positive BigDecimal montantFinance,
        BigDecimal montantEcheanceMensuelle,
        @NotNull @Positive Integer nombreTotalEcheances,
        @NotNull String devise,
        String periodicitePaiement
) {
    @AssertTrue(message = "Le rattachement à une entreprise ne fait pas partie du périmètre Individu.")
    public boolean isModeDansPerimetreIndividuel() {
        return modeRattachement != ModeRattachement.ENTREPRISE;
    }

package mg.cecam.bic.contrat;

import org.springframework.data.jpa.repository.JpaRepository;
import org.springframework.data.jpa.repository.Query;
import org.springframework.data.repository.query.Param;

import java.util.List;
import java.util.Optional;

public interface ContratRepository extends JpaRepository<Contrat, Long> {

    List<Contrat> findByClient_Id(Long clientId);

    @Query("""
            select distinct c from Contrat c
            where c.client.id = :clientId
               or exists (
                    select l.id from ContratLien l
                    where l.contrat = c and l.clientLie.id = :clientId
               )
            """)
    List<Contrat> findPourClient(@Param("clientId") Long clientId);

    List<Contrat> findAllByOrderByDateDemandeDesc();

    Optional<Contrat> findByCodeContratEtablissement(String codeContratEtablissement);

    @Query("select c from Contrat c where lower(c.codeContratEtablissement) = lower(:code) or lower(c.codeContratCb) = lower(:code)")
    Optional<Contrat> findByIdentifiantContrat(@Param("code") String code);

    @Query(value = "SELECT nextval('seq_code_contrat_cb')", nativeQuery = true)
    Long prochainCodeContratCb();
}
